recognize_zh: 視野中央有兩顆細胞質豐富、淡藍色、核偏位的淋巴球，另有一顆細胞質帶淡粉紅色細顆粒的淋巴球，周圍是分葉與帶狀嗜中性球；淋巴球細胞質量多是 LGL 的線索，但此倍率顆粒不易看清。
features: Several medium-to-large lymphocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Nuclei round to oval with condensed chromatin, nucleoli not seen
One lymphoid cell with faintly pink, finely granular cytoplasm; discrete azurophilic granules not clearly resolved
Admixed segmented and band neutrophils for comparison
Crush/smear artifact at lower left; red cells normochromic
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at intermediate power shows several lymphocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and mature condensed chromatin, clustered with segmented and band neutrophils. One lymphoid cell has faintly granular pinkish cytoplasm, but discrete azurophilic granules are not well resolved at this magnification. No blasts or atypical nucleolated cells are identified. The appearance is compatible with increased large granular lymphocytes in NK-cell lymphocytosis; confirmation requires an absolute LGL count and flow cytometric immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are pleomorphic with deeply basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and generally lack azurophilic granules.
Cannot be separated morphologically; requires flow cytometry (CD3, CD8, CD57, CD16/CD56) and TCR clonality testing.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm rather than round condensed nuclei.
